decimal.name: supplierScoreQiWeight
decimal.title: Open quality improvement weight
decimal.help: Weight of the open quality improvement rate in the supplier score. A weight of 0 excludes the indicator from the score. The indicator is ignored when the Quality app is not installed.

boolean.name: autoComputeSupplierOpenQiRate
boolean.title: Compute open quality improvement rate automatically
boolean.help: When disabled, the open quality improvement rate is entered manually on the partner form and is never overwritten by the automatic computation.
